title: Local privilege escalation in SmartUpdate.exe and SmartExecute.exe in INFINITT Healthcare Co., Ltd. (CVE-2026-16305)
description: A local privilege escalation vulnerability exists in SmartUpdate.exe and SmartExecute.exe components of INFINITT Healthcare Co., Ltd.'s INFINITT PACS. A low-privileged local attacker can modify a world-writable command manifest file named execlist.txt, which is processed during application updates, to execute arbitrary commands with administrator privileges.
